name: Andhra Pradesh
description: Andhra Pradesh, located in south-eastern India, features scenic Eastern Ghats hill towns, historical Buddhist ruins, and India's longest coastal coastline along the Bay of Bengal.

cuisine.name: Gongura Pachadi
cuisine.desc: Tangy local sorrel leaves ground into a fiery chutney.

cuisine.name: Putharekulu
cuisine.desc: Paper-thin wafer candy layers made from rice starch, sugar, and ghee.

streetFood.name: Punugulu
streetFood.desc: Crispy deep-fried fritters made from fermented rice and urad dal batter.

streetFood.name: Mirchi Bajji
streetFood.desc: Deep-fried green chillies stuffed with onions and lemon juice.

desserts.name: Bandar Laddu
desserts.desc: Smooth gram flour sweet melt-in-the-mouth specialty from Machilipatnam.

desserts.name: Ariselu
desserts.desc: Traditional sweet made of rice flour, jaggery, and sesame seeds.

festivals.name: Ugadi
festivals.desc: Telugu New Year celebrated with traditional Ugadi Pachadi parsing life flavors.

festivals.name: Visakha Utsav
festivals.desc: Tourism festival organized along Visakhapatnam beaches showcasing local heritage.

hiddenGems.name: Belum Caves
hiddenGems.desc: Deep underground black limestone caves featuring natural formations.

hiddenGems.name: Gadikota Fort
hiddenGems.desc: Ruined historic fort complex overlooking deep river gorges.

topDestinations.name: Araku Valley
topDestinations.desc: Mist-covered hill station famous for coffee plantations and tribal museums.

topDestinations.name: Tirupati Temple
topDestinations.desc: World famous Venkateswara temple located on Tirumala hills.

travelTips: Always check train bookings well in advance for Tirupati trip
Sample local spicy Andhra food thali with caution if sensitive to spice

Winter.weatherDesc: Cool breeze from the coast, pleasant weather across Araku hills and heritage temple sites.

food.name: Gongura Mutton
food.desc: Spicy mutton curry cooked with sorrel leaves.

locations.name: Araku Valley
locations.highlight: Lush coffee valleys and fresh cool hill mist.

travelTips: Carry light woolen jacket for Araku night breeze

Spring.weatherDesc: Warm temperatures, pleasant evenings, and vibrant Ugadi cultural celebrations.

food.name: Ugadi Pachadi
food.desc: New Year chutney combining six different tastes.

locations.name: Amaravati Buddhist Heritage Sites
locations.highlight: Peaceful stupas illuminated for spring events.

travelTips: Enjoy the temple festivals but stay hydrated during the day

Summer.weatherDesc: Hot humid coastal breeze, high heatwaves. Best to visit hill stations or air-conditioned museums.

food.name: Nannari Sharbat
food.desc: Cooling herbal root drink with lemon juice.

locations.name: Kondapalli Craft Village
locations.highlight: Watch toy-making workshops inside shaded setups.

travelTips: Avoid walking outdoors between 12 PM and 4 PM

Monsoon.weatherDesc: Frequent rainfall, lush green valleys, and spectacular roaring waterfalls across Eastern Ghats.

food.name: Mirchi Bajji
food.desc: Spicy stuffed fritters, perfect for rainy evenings.

locations.name: Talakona Waterfalls
locations.highlight: Spectacular forest canopy walk and waterfalls.

travelTips: Carry raincoats and caution for slippery trekking rocks

accessibility.comments: Ramp access is mostly limited to newer Visakhapatnam beaches and main Tirupati lines.
